title: Notice Board

steps.prompt: A village notice board: two thick wooden posts holding a broad plank board with a small shingle roof on top, a few square paper notices painted flat on the board, chunky solid shapes. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG prop art, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, carefully designed surface detail, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, only the object described and nothing else on it, original design, no characters, no faces, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 2000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 2.2 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_prp_notice_board.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=1887 final_tris=1887 dims=2.200x0.956x1.857 tex=1024. Made for Huskhaven as a small town (decision 0016). Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
